settings.frontend_logos_hint: These logos appear only on the public site. The backend always uses the favicon. Optionally upload a second logo for dark mode.
settings.favicon_hint: Shown in the browser tab and the backend. Recommended: monochrome SVG that adapts to the theme color automatically.

settings.site_name_hint: Shown in the browser tab, the public header when selected below, and the admin interface.

settings.theme_desc: Choose the admin interface appearance and customize brand colors.
settings.dark_section_hint: Leave fields empty to inherit values from the light theme. Click the ↺ icon to reset a field to auto.
settings.primary_color_hint: Used for buttons, links, and interactive elements.
settings.accent_color_hint: Used for highlights and brand accents.
settings.sidebar_bg_hint: Automatically derived from the primary color; can be overridden.

settings.button_radius_hint: Controls the roundness of editor buttons (0 = square, 24 = pill).
settings.admin_language_hint: Language for the admin interface. Default follows the site's primary language.
settings.email_desc: Configure how the contact form sends emails. Messages are always saved locally in the admin inbox, even if sending fails.
settings.sendmail_hint: Uses the server's built-in mail function (PHP mail). For emails to be delivered reliably, the server's IP address must be authorized to send mail for the sender domain (SPF record). This method works without credentials but delivery is not guaranteed.
settings.recipient_email_hint: Contact form messages are sent to this address.
settings.from_email_hint: The 'From' address shown to the recipient. Should match your SMTP account or domain.
settings.smtp_password_hint: Leave empty to keep the saved password unchanged.
settings.test_email_success: Test email sent successfully! Check your inbox.
settings.recipient_required: Please enter a recipient email address first.
settings.danger_zone_desc: Irreversible actions. Proceed with extreme caution.
settings.total_reset_desc: Completely resets the installation to factory state. Deletes all content, pages, images, news, backups, settings, and configuration. After the reset, the setup wizard will appear as if Nibbly was freshly installed.
settings.total_reset_warning: This action is irreversible. All data will be permanently deleted.
settings.total_reset_mismatch: Please type DELETE exactly to confirm.
toast.total_reset_success: Installation reset. Redirecting to setup wizard...

settings.backup_desc: Thanks to Nibbly's flat-file architecture, backups are quick and simple — download a complete copy of your site including all content, templates, images, and configuration.
settings.backup_site_desc: Creates a ZIP archive of the entire site directory. Development files (node_modules, .git, etc.) are excluded.
settings.restore_desc: Upload a previously downloaded Nibbly backup ZIP to restore your site.
settings.restore_full_desc: Replaces everything — CMS files, content, images, and configuration. A backup of the current state is created automatically before restoring.
settings.restore_content_desc: Replaces only your content, images, fonts, and page templates. CMS core files and admin credentials remain unchanged.
settings.restore_warning_full: This will replace your entire site with the contents of the backup ZIP. A backup of the current state will be created first. This cannot be undone easily. Are you sure?
settings.restore_warning_content: This will replace all content, images, fonts, and page templates with the contents of the backup ZIP. CMS core files and your login credentials will not be affected. Continue?
settings.scheduled_backups_desc: Run periodic full-site backups via a server cron job or a secret web-cron URL. The retention rules below decide how many tiered copies to keep — tight enough for fast incident recovery, loose enough to surface issues that only show up months later.
settings.scheduled_enabled_hint: When off, the server or web cron exits without doing anything. Manual backups via the button above still work.
settings.cron_mode_hint: Server cron is more reliable. Web cron is meant for hosts that do not provide cron jobs.
settings.retention_hint: Backups are tagged daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly when they're created. The numbers below say how many of each tier to keep before the oldest of that tier is deleted.
settings.storage_limit_hint: Hard cap on total backup storage. When reached, the oldest non-manual backups are deleted even if they're still within retention. 0 = no cap.
settings.remote_backups_hint: After each scheduled backup, Nibbly uploads the ZIP to every enabled target. Uploads are placed in a per-site subfolder below the configured remote path. Access tokens and passwords are saved in settings and hidden after saving.
settings.remote_oauth_beta_note: Beta note: Browser-based connections to Dropbox, Google Drive, and Microsoft OneDrive may be limited depending on the providers' approval status.
settings.remote_delete_confirm: Delete this backup from remote storage? The local copy is not affected.
settings.remote_hint_sftp: Requires an SSH/SFTP account and the PHP ssh2 extension on the Nibbly server.
settings.remote_hint_ftp: Use this for classic FTP accounts such as Plesk FTP users. Enable FTPS when the server supports encrypted FTP.
settings.remote_error_google_access_toke: Google Drive access token is missing.
settings.remote_error_ssh2_required: PHP ssh2 extension is required for SFTP/SCP uploads.
settings.remote_error_ftp_required: PHP FTP extension is required for FTP/FTPS uploads.
settings.cron_setup_hint: Create a daily scheduled task at 03:00. In Plesk choose “Run a PHP script”, enter the script path, and set the arguments to --action=run. This avoids relying on a php command in Plesk's PATH. If you use “Run a command”, use the absolute path to the PHP CLI binary.
settings.web_cron_hint: If your host does not allow cron jobs, call this secret URL once per day through an external service such as cron-job.org or easycron.com. Anyone who knows this URL can start scheduled backups.
settings.last_run_warning: Cron has not run in {days} days — verify the crontab is active.
settings.backup_list_empty: No backups stored yet. Run the cron job once or click "Create backup now" above.
settings.backup_delete_confirm: Delete this backup? This cannot be undone.
settings.backup_restore_pool_warning_ful: This will replace your entire site with the contents of the selected backup. A new backup of the current state is created first. Continue?
settings.backup_restore_pool_warning_con: This will replace your content, images, fonts, and page templates with the contents of the selected backup. CMS core files and your login credentials are not affected. Continue?

settings.email_inactive_hint: Email sending is disabled. Contact form submissions will be saved locally but no emails will be sent. Enable SMTP or Sendmail to send emails.
settings.menus_desc: Manage the order of pages in each navigation menu.

icons.svg_hint: Paste SVG inner markup or a full <svg>. Nibbly stores only the inner markup and adds the outer <svg> with a 24x24 viewBox when rendering. Scripts, event handlers, external references, and unsupported tags are removed on save.
icons.rename_warning: Existing JSON content may still reference the old icon key and will then fall back to the default icon.
icons.rename_confirm: Rename this icon key? Existing content may still reference the old key.
